summary: ATRenew Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports a 32.4% year-over-year revenue increase to RMB6,160.1 million and a 215.7% rise in net income to RMB135.1 million. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
